info.name: Check if token approval is required

items.docs: Allows the requestor to check if the `walletAddress` has the required approval to transact the `token` up to the `amount` specified. If the `walletAddress` does not have the required approval, the response will include a transaction to approve the token spend. If the `walletAddress` has the required approval, the response will return the approval with a `null` value.
